agentCard.name: Refinement Agent
agentCard.description: Decomposes an implementation-ready Jira story into subtasks and assigns each to the agent role required to implement it.

skills.name: Decompose story
skills.description: Breaks a validated Jira story down into self-contained subtasks, one per required agent role, and assigns each an owner.

agentCard.name: Backend Agent
agentCard.description: Implements APIs, business logic, and data persistence.

skills.name: Implement backend change
skills.description: Implements, verifies, and opens a pull request for a backend subtask's described behavior.

agentCard.name: Frontend Agent
agentCard.description: Implements UI, components, styling, and client-side logic.

skills.name: Implement frontend change
skills.description: Implements, verifies, and opens a pull request for a frontend subtask's described behavior.

agentCard.name: DevOps Agent
agentCard.description: Owns pipelines, infrastructure, and deployment configuration.

skills.name: Operate CI/CD pipeline
skills.description: Maintains, triages, and troubleshoots the pipeline connecting GitHub, Jenkins, and Jira for a project.

agentCard.name: Desktop Agent
agentCard.description: Implements native desktop-app UI and platform integration (e.g. Tauri) — a first-class role so desktop projects no longer have to reuse the Frontend Agent's channel as a workaround.

skills.name: Implement desktop change
skills.description: Implements, verifies, and opens a pull request for a desktop-app subtask's described behavior.
